text_block_list.name: Young Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Ahhh!
A big cicada shell!
Hey, look! Big si...

text_block_list.name: Young Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah............
That's right... she's not—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—"MSIC"...
In other words, Sounds of Earth wants to perform "Music" for Neo Universe...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!
The amore that builds up for you day after day, I can no longer keep it locked in my chest!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yet, alas! What tragedy.
You are busy, and I am stuck with remedial classes...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A spacetime "misalignment" is occurring.
Project schedule... blank.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-mmm-mmm-mmmah~!
Sounds like you have some kind of trouble going on here!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hah! I see it! In short, it's: "I want to bestow the music of affection, but our schedules do not align!"
That's what's going on, right!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Esattamente!
As expected of the Priestess of Felicita.
Are those beautiful eyes of yours a clairvoyance that sees through to truth?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The Goddess of Fate is a fickle one.
It cannot be helped; let us await her next visitation.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Fukukitaru-san!
Could you divine an auspicious day for us?
Next month has plenty of fermatas.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Next month, you say...?
No, it must not be so far ahead!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fate is something that can cruelly slip away!
If you postpone it, good fortune will slip away too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The auspicious day indicated by divination is important, but "No time like the present!" is also true!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see...? Fate is something carved out by one's own hands.
I'm astonished! You are quite valiant, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it is absolute truth!
If you have time to chat like this, you should do it!
Right now!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Right now!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sfera... Sfera...!
"SEDAM"... It was transmitted.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I am filled with deep emotion...!
I should have done this so much sooner!
Grazie, Fukukitaru-san!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all♪
This too is the divine guidance of Lady Shiraoki!
Never let happiness escape! Hug-hug hold!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you guys.
Thought I heard some nice tunes coming from over here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That was lovely~.
It made me feel so warm and cozy inside~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Both of you!
Isn't that right, isn't that right~♪

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth transmitted "Affection" via "MSIC"...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Affection, is it~?
Earth-sama and Universe-sama are always on such wonderful terms, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That makes it even more wonderful.
We rarely get the opportunity to directly say "I love you" like that, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Something like that, you just say whenever you feel like saying it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Stego-sama~.
Have you conveyed that to the precious people in your life lately, then?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Whoops, pretty sharp there.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In that case!
You two should convey your feelings right now as well!
Through some wonderful method!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Splendid idea!
Together with the sweet lingering resonance of musik, let us all express even more and more love!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes!
If five of us do it, fivefold happiness is guaranteed!
Now then, now then, what shall we make~~!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Funnyaka~! Hannyaka~~!!
Namu-namu-na~! Show us the way~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Fungyaro!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see it!!
"Sweets"!
We shall all bake sweetsss together!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this! Good-luck cookie baking!
We'll pack them full of love and fortune to give as gifts!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, knead the butter gently~♪
Work in some air~, make it nice and fluffy~~.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a gentle, largo metallic chime...!
Along with this rhythm, I too shall... the egg... the egggg...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Dogyaaah!
Earth-san, your hands are trembling like crazy!?
Um! The other way around! A quick tap against the edge~~!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't tense up like that.
Here, let me have it.
I'll show you how it's done.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew...!
You saved us~, Stego-sa~n!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time for a prayer around here!
A pinch of miraculous salt for purification, and now to inject lucky power—!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Powder dispersion... particle size already uniform.
Preparation for "Docking" is all green.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fuga! Wait a sec, stooop!
Nyamu-nyamu-nyamu~! Sprinkle salt~!
Become delicious~! Kieeei!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The oven is a "SRDNG" box...
Can the "Maillard reaction"... occur?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: While we have time, let's melt the chocolate for decorating~...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Aah! Why is this happening!?
Why are you being so stubborn...!
Fufufu, what a difficile child!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Steam must have gotten inside~.
We must hurry more~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Oh my? Where did Stego-sama go~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Migyaa! She's gone!?
Come to think of it, she vanished quite a while ago!
I'll go look for her~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Haa! Haa...!
I-I found youuu~!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Oh, are they baked already?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Very soon!
They're turning a lovely fox-brown color~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's not the point!
I won't let you wander off this time!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is... an important thing.
By the time you regret not doing it, it'll already be too late!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: So I need you to see it through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on♪ Let's head back~!
Just one more push! Funnyarome!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
And here I wondered why you were trying so hard—
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober~, Ryan-oneesama~.
Please, accept this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To my dearest Mejiro family.
Filled with my everyday gratitude...♪

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yo~, you in here?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Giving you this.
For my cute, cute kids.
...What, once in a while is fine.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
La~ lalala~~ la~~~♪
Oh distant~ astronauta~♪
This dolce is just for you~♪

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Crossing "Feelings"...
Initiating "Orbital Resonance".

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nyohohoho...!
Looks like everyone delivered theirs smoothly!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right, after all...
You have to tell them while you still can.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now then, I suppose I should too—
(Chiiin————)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Namu-namu...
Na~mu-namu-namu...

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you came home so suddenly and made an offering right away.
Did they turn out that well?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufun♪
I poured my whole heart into them, you see!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Right... Big Sis?

text_block_list.name: Young Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... *sob*...
Big siiis...
You're not here anymore...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Just kidding... The me who cried every time she remembered isn't here anymore, so please rest easy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Namu-namu...
A na~mu-namu to the heavens too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I don't know
if it will reach you, though.
Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One evening, I spotted Matikanefukukitaru, who seemed to have just returned from going out right before curfew.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san!
Good work today! Are you heading home now?
It got completely late for both of us, didn't it~?

She smiled as usual.
Yet, was it just my imagination? For some reason,
she seemed to carry a strange quietness unlike her usual self.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Sharp eyes, aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...! Something might have happened, or maybe it didn't,
or maybe it's just the usual, I guess~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well! It's nothing at all!
So with that, good night to you!
May tomorrow bring good fortune☆ and be a wonderful day~♪

She ran off in a flurry.
Beneath that bustling smile, I felt as if
I caught a fleeting glimpse of something deep inside.
